description: Web resources from files on this computer: listed files, or every file of a folder. A file whose content is already there plans nothing.

solution.description: Unique name of the unmanaged solution the web resources go into. Its publisher decides the prefix.

path.description: Absolute path of the file. The extension decides the type: html, css, js, xml, png, jpg, gif, xap, xsl, ico, svg, resx.

name.description: The web resource's name, starting with the publisher prefix, for example con_/project/form.js. Default: basePath plus the file name.

folder.description: Absolute path of a folder: every file in it and its subfolders with a known extension becomes a web resource named basePath plus its path in the folder.

basePath.description: For folder, and for files without a name: the start of each name, for example con_/project/. Default: the publisher prefix and _/.
